name: Hand Quilters
character: Forest and cream, a hoop on every lap: big-stitch, rocking stitch, and thimbles that have names.

sections.title: {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: {{guild_name}} quilts by hand. Machines stay home. We meet {{meeting_info}} with hoops, frames, and a pot of tea.

sections.heading: Stitch night
sections.note: Chairs in a ring. A standing frame in the corner for anyone who wants to try a larger quilt. Needles in a tin if you forgot yours.

items.title: Hoop circle
items.body: Eighteen-inch hoops, big stitch or rocking stitch, whatever your hands prefer that week.

items.title: Standing frame
items.body: A full quilt on poles. Two or three people can sit a side. Sign the sleeve when you add a row.

items.title: Thimble swap
items.body: Leather, metal, and the ones with a ridge. Try before you buy a new one.

sections.title: Join {{guild_name}}
sections.body: Dues are collected once a year.

sections.title: About {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: A hand-work guild in {{city}}. We do not plug anything in.

sections.heading: How we started
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: {{guild_name}} grew out of a bee that refused to move to machines when the rest of the town did. We still piece on machines at home. The quilting, the part that shows, is done with a needle. Whole cloth, sashiko-adjacent running stitch, and the old rocking stitch all sit at the same table.

items.title: Spring whole cloth
items.body: One marked top, no piecing, everyone quilts a section at the frame.

items.title: Summer porch
items.body: Outdoor stitch nights when the room is too warm. Bring a clamp light.

items.title: Winter slow
items.body: Shorter meetings, heavier thread, wool batting samples on the side table.

sections.title: Hoops and Frames
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: What we keep in the room and what you should bring.

items.title: Hoops
items.body: We have 14 and 18 inch. Q-snaps live in a bin. Bring your own if you are particular about tension.

items.title: The oak frame
items.body: Takes a queen. We roll together at 7:15. Do not turn a pole without the person on the other side.

items.title: Thread
items.body: Cotton 28wt and 12wt on the shelf. Silk if you ask. We do not keep polyester in the tin.

sections.heading: Hands
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: If arthritis has changed your stitch, say so. We have larger needles and a table clamp. Hand quilting here is not a contest for tiny stitches.

sections.title: Membership
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Dues keep the room, the tea, and the oak frame in good repair.

items.q: May I bring a machine-quilted top to bind?
items.a: Bind at home or at a finishing guild. This night is for stitching in the quilt.
Sit next to someone on the frame. The first ten minutes are the lesson.
